title: EXCLUSIVE: Beauty Power Couple Victoria Jackson and Bill Guthy Join Forces to Take Over the Color Cosmetics Industry
summary: Guthy has been named chief executive officer of No Makeup Makeup, the tech-driven brand founded by Jackson in 2024.
